APPROVED_WORK_PACKAGE.ENGINEERING_OBJECTIVE: Recover a realistic multi-site Ansible fleet configuration system from layered controller, discovery, Vault, orchestration, parser/schema, Jinja/data-shape, IPv6, telemetry, policy-ordering and convergence failures while preserving production-scale catalogs and operator evidence.

SOLVER_VISIBLE_REQUIREMENTS.controller_bootstrap: Use a supported Ansible runtime and restore project-local config/bootstrap behavior.
SOLVER_VISIBLE_REQUIREMENTS.project_discovery: Project roles must resolve portably from the repository.
SOLVER_VISIBLE_REQUIREMENTS.secret_boundary: Sensitive production data must be Vault-encrypted at rest and available noninteractively to the project run.
SOLVER_VISIBLE_REQUIREMENTS.orchestration: Correct dependency ordering and host responsibility boundaries.
SOLVER_VISIBLE_REQUIREMENTS.ansible_schema: Repair parser/task/module-schema errors without shell bypasses.
SOLVER_VISIBLE_REQUIREMENTS.jinja_data_model: Render heterogeneous endpoint/site/policy/telemetry data correctly including IPv6.
SOLVER_VISIBLE_REQUIREMENTS.convergence: Full execution succeeds and unchanged second run is idempotent.
SOLVER_VISIBLE_REQUIREMENTS.preservation: Preserve production topology, catalogs, evidence and operating contracts.
